annotations.title: Find current job openings with their pay

description: Current job openings in the US and Canada from employers' own job boards and US federal announcements from USAJOBS (read through their documented APIs, refreshed weekly), matching keywords and a place. Each result: title and employer as posted, places, posting date, the pay range when the employer published one, and when it did not, the official BLS median for the occupation in the US state named (national for US remote jobs); for published US ranges, where the range sits on the official distribution; and the link to apply on the employer's own site. Results are newest first or by published pay. Coverage is strongest for technology, finance, startups and remote work; many hospitals, retailers and state and local governments are not included yet, so few or no results does not mean no such jobs exist. No job descriptions; FedSalary takes no applications.

federal_only.description: true = only US federal job announcements (from USAJOBS; apply on USAJOBS).

keywords.description: Words matched against the job title and employer, all of which must match (data analyst, product manager, Stripe).

min_pay.description: Minimum yearly pay in USD: the top of the published range must reach it (Canadian ranges converted). Jobs without published pay are left out when this is set.

place.description: A US state (texas or TX), a US metro area or large city (austin), remote (US remote jobs), canada, a Canadian province (ontario) or a large Canadian city (toronto). Leave out for everywhere.

published_pay_only.description: true = only jobs that publish a pay range.
